item.title: Hebrew Language Olympiad sets participation record with students from 14 countries
item.description:
A record 9,286 students from Israel and around the world competed in the 2026 Hebrew Language Olympiad, Tel Aviv University announced. The international track – run in partnership with Brandeis University – drew roughly 800 overseas participants, up from approximately 200 the previous year. Students from 14 countries, including Egypt, Japan, the US and Canada, took part in the competition.
